'''Margan''' was a diplomat from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Shawken]], and a part of [[Santor]]'s government in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Margan was present during Santor's meeting with diplomats from the [[Alliance of Free Planets]], and proposed Santor to represent Shawken in the new galactic government. Margan later accompanied Santor and the Alliance representatives&mdash;including [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]&mdash;into Shawken's ancient ruins to disable the [[Shawken Device]], a forgotten [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] that had been inadvertently activated after the diplomats' arrival.<ref name="marvel87" />
